text:
deploy-bot: Starting deploy group 'release/2026-03-22/llm-route-v2'. Planned feature flag changes: enable llm_route_v2 to 5% -> 25% over 20m, pin version v2.1.3 for canary. Will post checks.
sandra: Copy. I'll watch latency heatmaps and error-rate. Canary cohort is EU and US-east.
kai: FYI: there's a known small mem-growth on v2.1.3 in QA but it stabilizes after ~6m. Oncall should watch pod restarts.
oncall-bot: Alerting channels subscribed: #eng-sre, #incidents. CPU > 70% for 3m will page.
deply-bot: Canary toggle command queued: `./ff-cli set llm_route_v2 --percent 5 --region eu,us-east --note "canary start"`
ellie: I'll run the quick smoke evals and send top-of-stack failure rates. If replica restarts >2 in 10m, we rollback to 0% and unpin.
sandra: Ops: please hold manual pin if autoscaler does >1 scale-up in first 10m. We don't want cascading resizes.
ops-runner: Acknowledged. I will hold `version.pin=on` only after 10m if stable. Posting heartbeat every 5m.
deply-bot: Canary reached 5% at 1768342160. Telemetry: p95 latency +2ms, error-rate +0.02%. No restarts.
kai: Seeing a small uptick in E2E failures for a subset of requests hitting long context paths. Not huge but tracking.
ellie: Smoke eval: rerank accuracy stable, small latency blip. Marking as green.
sandra: Let's proceed to 15% now. Command: `./ff-cli ramp llm_route_v2 --to 15 --step 10m --by 5`
deply-bot: Ramp command executed. Next check in 10m.
oncall-bot: Reminder: quiet window 23:00-05:00 UTC — any rollback during quiet window requires @sre lead signoff.
ops-runner: Noted. If we hit >0.5% error delta sustained for 5m, we will abort and pinback.
deply-bot: At 1768342300 ramp paused: autoscaler triggered 2x within 6m in us-east. Rolling back to 0% and unpinning version. Reason: pod churn risk.
sandra: Thanks — good call. Can someone open a follow-up ticket with logs and sample request ids?
ops-runner: Creating ticket INF-4821 with logs and pod event dump.
kai: Will root-cause memory behavior in QA branch vs prod config.
ellie: Reverting rollout notes in release draft and adding regression test for long-context paths.
oncall-bot: Incident reminder posted to #incidents. Paging on-call SRE.
sandra: Closing thread — we will re-schedule canary after fix and small config tweak. :thumbsup:
